Title: HC-Series High Performance Computing VMs now available in South Central US

Body.Content:
HC Virtual Machines feature 44 Intel Xeon Platinum 8168 CPU cores, 352 GB of RAM, and no hyperthreading. HC-series VMs support Intel’s rich ecosystem of software tools such as the Intel Math Kernel Library, and feature an all-cores clock speed greater than 3 GHz for most workloads.

To drive optimal at-scale message passing interface (MPI) performance, HC Virtual Machines feature 100 Gb/s EDR InfiniBand from our technology partners at Mellanox.

Learn more
